# Text

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:text` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

Semantic native paragraph text by default, with heading and inline-span variants plus composable semantic presentation roles.

## When to use

Render paragraph semantics by default, h1 through h6 when selected, or geometry-free inline secondary text as a span while independently configuring quiet or danger tone, compact size, or monospace font.

- Render ordinary application headings or paragraphs with native document semantics, or inline secondary text inside rows, labels, and table cells.

**Not when:**

- Do not use Text for toolbar identity or title content; use ToolbarText inside a Toolbar zone.
- Do not choose a heading variant for visual size alone; preserve the document heading hierarchy.

**Alternatives:**

- [ToolbarText](./toolbar-text.md) (toolbar-specific)
- [ListInsetText](./list-inset-text.md) (list-geometry-specific)

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/text` — exports `Text`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/text` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/text.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/text`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuitext) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- p, h1 through h6, or inline span semantic variant
- default, quiet, or danger tone
- default or compact size
- default or monospace font

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** semantic variant; tone; size; font; copy; document heading hierarchy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Block Text variants reset native margins and add a 1px transparent border plus the standard 8px item padding; span has no margin, border, or padding.

## Accessibility

- Text renders a native paragraph by default; choose an h1 through h6 variant by document outline rather than appearance, or span for inline secondary text.
- Ordinary global, data, and ARIA attributes pass through to the native element.
- Choose tone, size, and font independently of the heading level so appearance does not distort the document outline.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-text`.

Never put `kui-text` on an element you write; render `Text` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-color-danger-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-text-quiet`, `--kui-font-mono`, `--kui-font-xs`, `--kui-layout-item-padding`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
